trustedTenant: query.tenantId must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before Owner access; no tenant switching

fact.source: one tenant-scoped ProjectMasterDO row from proj_project
fact.required: positive tenantId/projectId/customerId/departmentId; non-negative projectVersion; normalized nonblank projectCode/customerCode/departmentCode length 1..64; normalized nonblank projectName/customerName/departmentName length 1..255
fact.customerSemantics: customerCode/customerName are the project occurrence snapshot; they are not CUS current-master or service-level truth
fact.departmentSemantics: departmentId/departmentCode/departmentName are the project occurrence snapshot from the same row and are displayed by CUT as the office context; the public DTO does not introduce officeCode aliases and CUT does not resolve SYSTEM current organization for this snapshot

expectedFact.source: copied without truncation or renaming from the previous inspect FOUND currentFact
expectedFact.validation: same field constraints as fact; expectedFact.tenantId/projectId must equal the enclosing query identities
expectedFact.authority: concurrency guard only; never persisted as the locked current Owner fact

expectedFactServerConstruction: CUT adds trusted tenantId; requires wire projectId to equal the selected project; maps wire officeDepartmentId/officeCode/officeName exactly to departmentId/departmentCode/departmentName; copies every other field unchanged from the previous FOUND response; the client may only echo this complete previous snapshot as a concurrency guard and CUT persists only the locked FOUND currentFact

resultUnion.FOUND: currentFact is complete and decision is FOUND
resultUnion.VERSION_CONFLICT: lockAndRevalidate only; currentFact is the complete current fact

revalidation.match: same tenantId/projectId, ACTIVE lifecycle, complete current fact and every current fact field exactly equals expectedFact returns FOUND
revalidation.versionMismatch: any difference in projectVersion, project/customer/department identity or display fields returns VERSION_CONFLICT with current complete non-sensitive fact; no business write
revalidation.inactive: return INACTIVE for lifecycle other than ACTIVE
revalidation.ownerCorruption: throw OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED; never return a partial FOUND

consumerMapping.scope: CUT separately uses ProjectScopeApi PROJECT_VIEW/PROJECT_EDIT and treeVersion; projectVersion never substitutes for scopeVersion
consumerMapping.resolveCreateContext: FOUND supplies project and department occurrence facts plus trusted customerId/code/name; CUT maps department to the office display and then calls CustomerServiceLevelFactApi by customerId
consumerMapping.createAndSubmit: CUT passes the complete previously displayed FOUND fact to lockAndRevalidate and freezes only the exact currentFact returned by the locked FOUND result

forbidden: CUT reads proj_project or SYSTEM/CUS tables
CUT combines ProjectScopeResult, ProjectOrganizationFact and CustomerSummaryDTO into an unversioned fact
client-originated customer or office values are treated as authority or persisted without locked Owner revalidation
project customer snapshot is presented as current CUS master truth
